notes.title: Chapter 3 Available - Find the EMP
notes.content:
Story
You will have to fight against the AI (Trinity) to access to the third Item (An EMP) in order to help Keanu to save the Listenbourg.


Features

 Order the drones to go to a specific location thanks to a control map
 Hive AI improved for the Player And Trinity (the enemy)
 Some Box are added in each level to help the player to handle Trinity agressivity at the start.



Design
Smoother highlighting items

notes.title: Chapter 2 Available - Find the Antenna
notes.content:
Story 
You will have to fight against the AI (Trinity) to access to a specific item (an antenna) in order to help Keanu to save the Listenbourg.

Features 
Build new constructions.
 
 a building to produce screw
  a building to produce big sticks
  construct box (you have to guess why !)


Screw driver available

An inventory is available

 you can store most of grabbed item in your inventory
 you can see the inventory on your right hand
 you can grab item from your inventory with your left hand aiming
